name: FOODIO
tagline: A modern food delivery web experience designed to help users quickly discover, explore, and order their favourite meals through an intuitive and visually engaging interface.
problem:
Food delivery platforms often contain a large amount of information, making it difficult for users to quickly discover what they want. Complex navigation, crowded interfaces, and poorly structured food categories can increase the time required to find a suitable meal.

FOODIO addresses this challenge by creating a simplified browsing experience where users can immediately understand the service, explore food categories, and discover popular dishes without unnecessary complexity.
solution:
FOODIO uses a clean, visually driven interface centered around food discovery.

The experience provides:

* A prominent hero section with a clear ordering message
* Quick access to the food menu
* Category-based food discovery
* Featured/popular dishes
* Strong food imagery
* Clear calls-to-action
* Fast-delivery messaging
* Mobile-app promotion
* Simple footer navigation and contact information

The overall approach prioritizes visual hierarchy and reduces friction between discovering food and taking action.
metaTitle: FOODIO — Online Food Delivery & Restaurant Discovery
metaDesc: Explore FOODIO, a modern food delivery web experience for discovering delicious meals, browsing food categories, and finding top-rated dishes with a fast and intuitive interface.
architecture:
FOODIO is built as a modern frontend-focused food delivery experience. React.js is used to structure the interface into reusable components, while responsive styling handles the visual presentation across different screen sizes.

The application is deployed through Vercel, providing a fast production environment and publicly accessible live demo.

name: VANTA
tagline: A premium luxury jewelry e-commerce experience built around quiet luxury, craftsmanship, high-end visual storytelling, and seamless product discovery.
problem:
Luxury jewellery websites need to communicate much more than product information. Customers need to feel the craftsmanship, heritage, quality, and exclusivity of a product before making a high-value purchase.

Traditional e-commerce interfaces can feel too transactional and fail to communicate the emotional value associated with luxury jewellery.

VANTA addresses this by combining e-commerce functionality with an editorial luxury experience, allowing users to discover products while simultaneously learning about the brand, materials, craftsmanship, and creation process.
solution:
VANTA creates a premium digital jewellery experience focused on storytelling and product discovery.

The platform provides:

* Immersive luxury-focused hero section
* Curated jewellery collections
* Product discovery and category navigation
* Signature product storytelling
* Brand heritage and philosophy
* Material-quality information
* Jewellery craftsmanship journey
* Bespoke customization messaging
* Customer testimonials
* Editorial journal
* Live gold and silver market rates
* Jewellery cost calculator
* Newsletter / private collection subscription
* Responsive e-commerce interface

The result is an experience that combines luxury branding, editorial storytelling, and commerce-oriented functionality.
metaTitle: VANTA — Luxury Jewelry | Timeless Precision & Fine Craftsmanship
metaDesc: Discover VANTA luxury jewelry — handcrafted fine jewellery, certified diamonds, premium gold collections, bespoke craftsmanship, and timeless designs created for a lifetime.
architecture:
VANTA follows a component-driven frontend architecture designed around reusable sections and interactive commerce components.

The interface separates major experiences such as the hero, product collections, craftsmanship storytelling, market-rate dashboard, jewellery calculator, journal, and subscription system into modular UI sections.

The architecture is designed to support responsive layouts, interactive product experiences, dynamic pricing information, and future expansion into a complete jewellery commerce platform.
